caseEvidence.heading: Evidence
caseEvidence.empty.title: No evidence yet
caseEvidence.empty.body: Attach a file, a link or a reference to an internal document. Sign-off needs at least one piece of evidence that has been checked.
caseEvidence.hint.pending: It can be opened once it has been checked for malware.
caseEvidence.hint.infected: The file was deleted. Its name and fingerprint stay on the case.
caseEvidence.hint.error: Nobody can open it. Remove it and attach the file again.
caseEvidence.removeBody: It leaves the list and no longer counts toward sign-off. The case file keeps its name, its fingerprint and the date it was removed.
caseEvidence.readOnly: Evidence can't be added or removed while the case waits for sign-off. Sending it back opens it again.
caseEvidence.kindFileHint: Checked for malware before anyone can open it.
caseEvidence.kindLinkHint: A web address. Nothing is fetched from it.
caseEvidence.kindReferenceHint: The name of an internal document kept elsewhere.
caseEvidence.name: Name
caseEvidence.documentHint: Where it is kept and which version, so a reviewer can find it.
caseEvidence.attachedFile: Attached. It can be opened once it has been checked for malware.
caseEvidence.scannerUnavailable: Files can't be checked for malware right now, so nothing was attached. Try again later.
caseEvidence.scanPending: This file is still being checked for malware. Try again in a minute.
caseEvidence.scanFailed: This file can't be opened because it did not pass the malware check.
